question: Near which sacred presences may the lamp rite be performed?
premises: The rite may be performed near Bhairava.
The rite may also be performed in the presence of śālagrāma.
inference: The lamp rite is appropriate near Bhairava or in the presence of śālagrāma.
plain_english: Near Bhairava, and also in the presence of the śālagrāma.
